needs-server: staticCapable is false or the plugin has routes
not-stable: lifecycle is experimental, deprecated or obsolete
reaches-any-host: egress lists { any: true } (destinations cannot be listed in advance)
admin-chosen-hosts: egress or privacy.recipients name a setting (admins choose where data goes)
reaches-given-url: egress lists { input: url } (only the host of the URL a person gives, during that call)
